text: Okay, let me see... hmm. I don't think I used a different name or email, no. I did get a bunch of emails, but I'm not sure which one has the right order number. It's kind of a pain to go through all of them, honestly. Is there any other way you could help me out? Maybe if I just tell you what I want to exchange?
zh: 好的，让我看看... 嗯。我不觉得我用了不同的名字或邮箱，没有。我确实收到了很多邮件，但我不确定哪个有正确的订单号。说实话，去处理所有这些邮件有点烦人。你还有其他办法可以帮到我吗？也许如果我直接告诉你我想换什么？
